description: A text based work that can be carried by physical or digital objects. Examples are the text for conservation reports, for journal articles, or exhibition catalogs.

Name.description: Link to the reified Name collection.

Identifier.description: Link to the reified Identifier collection.

Equivalent.description: This field is used to document a URI which is meant to indicate an equivalence between the documented textual work and a resolvable, structured reference resource that stands as a document for this self same entity.

Type.description: Link to the reified Abstract Work Type collection.

Text Content.description: This field is used to link the documented textual work to the actual string content of that textual work.

Format.description: This field is used to indicate the format of a textual work.

Text Language.description: This field is used to link the documented textual work to the language in which it is expressed.

Dimension.description: Link to the reified Dimension collection.

Creation.description: Link to the reified Creation collection.

Publication.description: Link to the reified Publication collection.

Part of Text.description: This field is used to link the documented textual work to another instance of textual work of which it is a part.

Physical Copy.description: This field is used to link the documented symbolic object to a physical object which acts as its material substrate.

Entity Intended.description: This field is used to link the documented textual work to the entity it is about.

Subject.description: This field is used to link the documented information object to the subject it is about.

Statement.description: Link to the reified Statement collection.

Depicting Image.description: This field  is used to record the existence of an image which depicts the documented textual work.

Digital Reference.description: Link to the reified Digital Reference collection.

Source Reference Work.description: This field is used to link the documented object to an instance of textual work which describes or documents it.

Owner.description: This field is used to link the documented abstract work to a actor whose custodianship is attributed to it in the ownership status.
